problem.passage:
A circular garden bed has center $O$. A straight walking path is tangent to the circle at point $P$. The distance from $O$ to a point $Q$ on the path is $10$ feet, and the length of segment $OP$ (the radius) is $6$ feet.

What is the length, in feet, of segment $PQ$?
problem.stimulus: A circular garden bed has center $O$. A straight walking path is tangent to the circle at point $P$. The distance from $O$ to a point $Q$ on the path is $10$ feet, and the length of segment $OP$ (the radius) is $6$ feet.
problem.question: What is the length, in feet, of segment $PQ$?
problem.explanation: 접선은 접점에서 그은 반지름과 항상 수직이므로 $\angle OPQ = 90^\circ$이다. 따라서 삼각형 $OPQ$는 직각삼각형이며, $OQ = 10$은 빗변, $OP = 6$은 한 변이다. 피타고라스 정리에 의해 $PQ = \sqrt{OQ^2 - OP^2} = \sqrt{10^2 - 6^2} = \sqrt{100 - 36} = \sqrt{64} = 8$ 이다.
problem.explanationEn: A tangent line is always perpendicular to the radius drawn to the point of tangency, so $\angle OPQ = 90^\circ$. This means triangle $OPQ$ is a right triangle with $OQ = 10$ as the hypotenuse and $OP = 6$ as one leg. By the Pythagorean theorem, $PQ = \sqrt{OQ^2 - OP^2} = \sqrt{10^2 - 6^2} = \sqrt{100 - 36} = \sqrt{64} = 8$.

difficultyReasons: 접선-반지름 수직 성질을 알면 피타고라스 정리 한 번 적용으로 풀림
필요한 추론 단계가 1단계(직각삼각형 인지 + 계산)로 매우 단순함
OQ=10, OP=6이 3-4-5 비율의 배수(6-8-10)로 계산이 깔끔함
